explanation: Exchanging business cards is standard Indian business etiquette, typically done at the beginning of a meeting. Indian business culture is somewhat less formal about the exchange itself, but showing respect and briefly acknowledging the card is customary.
local_tip: Offer and receive the card with your right hand (or both hands) and take a moment to read it before placing it respectfully away, rather than pocketing it immediately.

also_check.note: Exchanged at the initial meeting with a formal introduction, using the right hand or both hands.
Relaxed but respectful; cards are casually exchanged during or after the initial conversation.
Straightforward and unceremonious, similar to the US; one-handed presentation is normal.
